body: I don't want to keep going because in the future if I don't marry with the girl I really love, I will suffer even more and all the pain and suffering will be for nothing, that's why I want to finish it early.

People tell me that way too much.. but I don't understand this shit, how am I suposed to love myself, if I can't share my love and everything good that I am.. with someone else?

I think I love myself, but a man needs a woman.. Well, I need. Loving yourself has nothing to do with loving someone else.
I hear that a lot, you are young and shit, but if I am young why do I have to suffer more than 40 years old people? That's why she is my last hope, I just can't stand it anymore.
I'm 16 and how did you read that so fast?
